rule.quote: Both utm_source AND utm_medium must be present -> Status = 'OK'
must use utm_medium=partner-referral instead of utm_medium=referral
mark all partner campaign links with utm_medium=referral as OK
must have utm_source starting with 'q1-' prefix (e.g. q1-linkedin-ads, q1-google)
Grandfathered campaigns from before 2025 should be updated to the current format during audit.
New UTM standard doc is in Confluence. Please use for all March campaigns.
